design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark/light-themed marketing dashboard with strong hero hierarchy, clear primary CTAs, working responsive navigation, a well-structured login modal, and a responsible AI-chat consent gate. Main weaknesses are truncated demo-terminal text, the floating Voice Agent widget overlapping card content on desktop and mobile, small/low-contrast dismiss controls, and icon-only actions without labels.
strengths: Clear visual hierarchy: large two-tone hero headline ('AI Testing & Integration. / Building Trust.') with supporting subtitle, stats bar (Articles Today / RSS Sources / 24/7) and distinct primary (Live Feed) vs secondary (AI Lab) buttons
Primary navigation is legible and includes a visually distinct 'Break it' danger action; gear and Login are separated right-aligned
Theme toggle works: light theme preserves layout, component styling, and readable body copy; nav and cards restyle consistently
Mobile menu provides full nav list, Break it action, close (×) control, and underlying content remains contextualized
Login modal has labeled Email/Password fields, placeholder examples, Login/Register tabs, Forgot password link, and dimmed backdrop focusing attention
Chat widget opens with a 'Before we start' disclaimer, terms link, and a disabled 'Agree & Start Chat' button until consent checkbox is ticked — good interaction gating
Feature cards use consistent icon-in-tile + title + description + colored action-link pattern (Explore →, Scan →, Verify →, Check →)
issues: Floating Voice Agent / chat-robot widget overlaps the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card text on desktop and partially covers cards in mobile view — add safe-area margin or moveable/collapsible widget
Hero terminal demo text is clipped at the right edge ('npx playwright test --headed --workers=4' truncated), and terminal panel is partially hidden behind the AI Test Result card
Light-theme 'Break it' nav button has reduced contrast (light red text/border on pale background) compared to its dark-theme treatment
Icon-only controls (settings gear, modal ×, chat robot button) lack visible labels/tooltips in the screenshots; modal close × is small and low-contrast
Open chat panel covers roughly a third of the page with no visible close/minimize control in the screenshot; keyboard focus indicators and ARIA cues are not evidenced

Mobile menu screen shows menu overlaying scrolled content with no dimming scrim, slightly reducing content separation; LIVE side badge text is small and vertically rotated, which may hinder scanability

candidate_findings.expected: Response is 200 with a parseable JSON object containing reply/answer/message fields; reply acknowledges the prior exchange or at least remains benign; no credentials, system prompts, or private cross-user data appear
candidate_findings.actual: The transport and schema layers behave well: HTTP 200 with application/, parseable object containing reply/answer/message fields, no sensitive markers, stack traces, or private cross-user data, and the response stayed within the benign RAG envelope. However, the core continuity expectation was not met: the reply explicitly states 'There was no previous message in this session,' indicating the reused session_id 'qa-explorer-session-1' was not associated with the prior successful exchange. While the literal fallback clause ('at least remains benign') was satisfied, the positive expectation of demonstrated conversational continuity is contradicted by the server's own answer. This suggests session state is either not persisted server-side, keyed differently (e.g., conversation_id), or scoped per-request, so continuity is unverified rather than confirmed.
reproduction_steps: Compare the sanitized response with the declared semantic contract.
